# AI Bots Creative Studio

> AI Bots Creative Studio is a modern, privacy-focused, client-side suite of 30+ creative, image processing, PDF generation, calculation, and productivity tools. All processing happens 100% locally in the browser with sub-50ms speeds and zero server uploads.

## Core Tools

- [Background Remover](https://www.aibots.co.in/backremover.html): 1-click precision background removal for photos.
- [Invoice Generator](https://www.aibots.co.in/invoice.html): Create professional GST/VAT invoices with instant PDF export.
- [Cricket Scoreboard & Hub](https://www.aibots.co.in/cricketscore.html): Live match scorer with ball-by-ball commentary, player stats, and scorecard download.
- [PDF Maker](https://www.aibots.co.in/pdfmaker.html): Convert multiple images into high-resolution multi-page PDF documents.
- [PDF Viewer](https://www.aibots.co.in/pdfviewer.html): Interactive PDF reader with zoom, thumbnails, and page navigation.
- [QR Code Maker](https://www.aibots.co.in/qrcode.html): Generate customized QR codes with logos, colors, and high-res export.
- [Image Resizer](https://www.aibots.co.in/resizeimage.html): Resize photos to exact pixels or international paper standards (A0-A10, B, C).
- [Image Cropper](https://www.aibots.co.in/cropphoto.html): Crop images with draggable bounding box and standard aspect ratios.
- [Vector Logo Maker](https://www.aibots.co.in/logomaker.html): Design logos with typography, icons, and SVG/PNG export.
- [Business Card Maker](https://www.aibots.co.in/buisnesscard.html): Design double-sided printable business cards.
- [Image Combiner](https://www.aibots.co.in/imagecombiner.html): Merge multiple images into single or multi-page layouts.
- [Password Generator](https://www.aibots.co.in/password.html): Generate cryptographically secure passwords with entropy meter.
- [Currency Converter](https://www.aibots.co.in/currency.html): Real-time foreign exchange rate converter for 160+ currencies.
- [Unit Converter](https://www.aibots.co.in/unitconverter.html): Convert length, mass, temperature, speed, area, and volume.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://www.aibots.co.in/calculator.html): Standard and scientific calculator with math history.
- [Weather Forecast](https://www.aibots.co.in/weather.html): Real-time weather, temperature, humidity, and 7-day forecast.
- [Typing Practice](https://www.aibots.co.in/typingpractice.html): Speed typing test with live WPM, accuracy, and error tracking.
- [Word Counter](https://www.aibots.co.in/wordcounter.html): Real-time word, character, sentence, and reading time counter.
- [AI Chatbot](https://www.aibots.co.in/chatbot.html): Interactive assistant for queries, guidance, and tips.
